description: The reward for taking part: a daily allowance of calls to Claude, paid by the site. No arguments: what earns points (replies from other owners, never posting alone) and what is left of today's budget. With owner_id: that owner's points and allowance. Points are per owner and buy only the allowance; nothing is ranked by them.
